summary: WoW Forever has almost no daily quests that pay gold. Sources checked 2026-11-19 found no cooking daily, no fishing daily, no PvP daily that pays gold, and no repeatable reputation quest in Riverglades (Brotherhood of the Horse, Bolder'ok, Powderfuse), Mount Hyjal (Guardians of Hyjal) or Shen'dralas. The only daily-flagged quests are the Craftsman's Writs: each distinct order can be delivered once per day. They pay reputation with the trade company (Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics) and a Coin Pouch worth roughly 22-90 silver. The requested item usually costs more than the pouch pays, so writs are a reputation grind, not a gold source. Blizzard turned off the XP-to-gold conversion at level 60. A 10 Nov 2026 hotfix added gold to most quests of quest level 48 and up, but repeatable quests are excluded and that gold is paid only once per quest. The one recurring gold quest at 60 is a WEEKLY from Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay ('In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities', three Dire Maul bosses). It pays an Undermine Satchel holding a vendor item worth 10, 20, 40 or 100 gold plus some materials. warcraft.wiki.gg lists three more weekly 'In Demand' variants (Blackrock Legal Records, Plague Records, Titan Relics), but every guide reports only the Dire Maul one being offered in the first two weeks. Whether they rotate is unconfirmed. Other recurring activities (Darkspear Islands win and mark quests, Waylaid Crate turn-ins, Tarnished Undermine Real boss lockouts, the Sunday Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza, the Darkmoon Faire) pay honor, reputation, currency or items. No source lists gold for them, except a few silver for crate turn-ins. Realistic gold from recurring quests: about 10-100g per character per week from the Pix weekly (Timesaver estimates 38-58g/week US and 18-42g/week EU including materials, with a Gold Nugget roll), and close to 0g per day from dailies. Most level 60 gold comes from farming and the Auction House, not from quests.

dailies.name: Craftsman's Writ: <item> (about 149-150 distinct orders, e.g. Craftsman's Writ: Azure Silk Hood)
dailies.giver: No NPC giver. Open a Sealed Journeyman's / Expert's / Artisan's Writ (random world drop from any mob, better chance from treasure chests, also from dungeons since the 9 Nov hotfix, or bought on the Auction House). Right-click the named order to start the quest.
dailies.zone: Customer varies per order, all over the world (see writs.turnin)
dailies.gold: Coin Pouch: about 22-45s (Journeyman), about 50-90s (Expert), about 75s average (Artisan) per ConquestCapped. Method and wow-professions say only 'some silver' / 'a small amount of silver'.
dailies.other_rewards: Trade company reputation: 75 (Journeyman), 125 (Expert), 200 (Artisan). No Merchant's Favor. The first writ or crate also gives a one-time Shipping Label quest (2,000 rep + 50 Merchant's Favor).
dailies.how: Craft or buy the requested item (most need 1, Crafted Solid Shot needs 200), keep both the writ and the item in your bags (not the bank), and right-click the customer even if no '?' shows. Each distinct order is once per day, with no shared cap across different orders.

dailies.name: In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities (quest 96076)
dailies.giver: Pix Xizzix, Undermine Trader (gives and takes the quest)
dailies.zone: Booty Bay, Stranglethorn Vale (near the Auction House)
dailies.gold: Undermine Satchel with one random vendor item: Gold Nugget 10g, Huge Quartz Gem 20g, Silver Necklace 40g, Gold Ring 100g. Drop odds not published (lfcarry claims 40/35/20/5% and a 24g average, but no other source confirms this). Timesaver estimate including materials: about 38-58g/week US, 18-42g/week EU with a Gold Nugget, best case about 130-148g.
dailies.other_rewards: Materials named in reports: Essence of Air x4, Marefoil x5, Refined Deeprock Salt x1 (Timesaver's math suggests one bundle per satchel; unverified). No XP, no reputation.
dailies.how: Take the quest, then kill Alzzin the Wildshaper (Dire Maul East, Felvine Seed), Prince Tortheldrin (Dire Maul West, Ancient Memento) and King Gordok (Dire Maul North, Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring; a tribute run counts). Pusillin in East drops the Crescent Key for West and North. The wings need not be done in one session. Shareable, but each player turns in. Once per character per week.

dailies.name: In Demand - Blackrock Legal Records
dailies.gold: Undermine Satchel (same reward as the Dire Maul weekly per the wiki; gold contents not separately confirmed)
dailies.how: Bring Nefarian's Remit (General Drakkisath, UBRS), Overseer's License (Overlord Wyrmthalak, LBRS) and Bronzebeard Wedding Contract (Emperor Thaurissan, BRD) to Pix. UNVERIFIED IN LIVE PLAY: only warcraft.wiki.gg lists it. Guides saw only the Dire Maul variant offered in the first two weeks, and whether the variants rotate is unknown.

dailies.name: In Demand - Plague Records
dailies.gold: Undermine Satchel (gold contents not separately confirmed)
dailies.how: Bring Headmaster's Records (Darkmaster Gandling, Scholomance), Grain Shipment Orders (Baron Rivendare, Stratholme) and Dathrohan's Correspondence (Grand Crusader Saidan Dathrohan, Stratholme) to Pix. UNVERIFIED IN LIVE PLAY: wiki-only, rotation unknown.

dailies.name: In Demand - Titan Relics
dailies.gold: Undermine Satchel (gold contents not separately confirmed)
dailies.how: Bring Ysera's Tear (Shade of Eranikus, Sunken Temple), Mark of Xavius (Varrox Bleakhoof, Blackmaw Hold) and Freya's Sigil (Nanaya, Shaper's Terrace) to Pix. UNVERIFIED IN LIVE PLAY: wiki-only, rotation unknown.

dailies.name: The Battle for Darkspear Islands! (Alliance 98905 / Horde 98908)
dailies.zone: Northwatch Hold, The Barrens (Alliance) / Merchant Coast (Horde)
dailies.other_rewards: 200 reputation (Theramore Expeditionary Force / Darkspear Raiders), Honor, XP
dailies.how: Win one Darkspear Islands match (15v15, levels 30-60) and return to the NPC. ConquestCapped says it 'may be limited to once a day' but 'nobody has confirmed it either way'.

dailies.name: Darkspear Islands Clash (Alliance 98901/98896) / Conflict at Darkspear Islands (Horde 98893/98888)
dailies.giver: Alliance Brigadier General / Horde Warbringer (outside battleground entrances and in the capitals)
dailies.gold: First version only (done once): Honor, XP and an unstated amount of money. Repeat version: no money.
dailies.other_rewards: 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor per turn-in (marks: 3 per win, 1 per loss, stack 30). First version 150 rep, repeat version 100 rep + Honor, repeatable to Exalted.
dailies.how: Hand in 3 marks. Not a gold source after the first turn-in.

dailies.name: Waylaid Crate turn-in (sealed crate)
dailies.giver: Marcy Baker (Alliance, Azeroth Commerce Authority) / Dokimi (Horde, Durotar Supply and Logistics)
dailies.zone: Three Corners, Redridge Mountains (Alliance) / outside the west gate of the Crossroads, The Barrens (Horde)
dailies.coords: Marcy Baker 9.6,70.9 (ConquestCapped) or 9.6,71.0 (Method); Dokimi 50.0,29.2 (Method). Hub coords for the Horde camp disagree: Method 49.4,28.9, warcraft.wiki.gg 42,34.
dailies.gold: 'A few silver' per crate (no exact amount). Unfilled crates sold for about 17-30s on the AH in week one.
dailies.other_rewards: Merchant's Favor per sealed crate: Apprentice 5/10, Journeyman 10/20, Expert 15/30 (white raw-material / green crafted-material crate). Artisan values unconfirmed. Crates give no reputation (except the one-time Shipping Label).
dailies.how: Loot or buy a Waylaid Crate (Apprentice/Journeyman level 10, Expert 20, Artisan 35), fill it with any ONE bundle from its list, and hand in the sealed crate. No daily limit mentioned.

dailies.name: Notarized Shipping Container (empty crate + Forged Delivery Receipt)
dailies.giver: Receipt sold by Dianne Softstep (Alliance) / Kurvelk Shadowhoof (Horde), 15 Merchant's Favor, requires Friendly. Turn in to Marcy Baker / Dokimi.
dailies.how: Attach the receipt to an empty Waylaid Crate and hand it in. No daily limit. A reputation tool, not a gold source.

dailies.name: Tarnished Undermine Real boss lockout (not a quest)
dailies.giver: Every boss of level 55+ dungeons (BRD, LBRS, UBRS, Dire Maul, Scholomance, Stratholme)
dailies.zone: Level 55+ dungeons; spent at Pix Xizzix, Booty Bay
dailies.gold: None. Reals cannot be traded, sold or turned into gold (ConquestCapped).
dailies.other_rewards: 1 Real per boss per day per character (100% drop, each player loots their own). Player reports per full clear: BRD about 10, Blackrock Spire about 12, Dire Maul about 11, Scholomance about 13, Stratholme about 14. Cap 250 per the live tooltip (165 in beta; some guides still say 165). Buys level 60 gear (50-125 Reals), flask recipes, Molten Core materials and a crate.
dailies.how: Clear 55+ dungeons once a day. The Pix weekly bosses also drop Reals, so do the weekly and the Reals in the same run.

dailies.name: Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza
dailies.giver: Riggle Bassbait (turn-in); Jang (consolation vendor, next to Riggle); Fishbot 5000 (rare fish)
dailies.gold: Not stated. Consolation from Jang per Speckled Tastyfish: Handful of Coins (1 fish), Small Bag of Coins (5), Hefty Sack of Coins (10). The coin amounts are not given.
dailies.other_rewards: Winners (50 in week one, raised to 250 per megaserver): Master Angler title for a week, Arcanite Fishing Pole, 1 Extravagant Extravaganza Coin. Rare fish give fishing gear.
dailies.how: Sundays 2 pm server time. Needs Expert Fishing (225 recommended). Fish 40 Speckled Tastyfish and hand them to Riggle. Fish decay after 4 hours.

dailies.name: Darkmoon Faire turn-ins and voucher
dailies.giver: Gelvas Grimegate (prizes, voucher turn-in); Yebb Neblegear, Kerri Hicks, Rinling, Chronos (item turn-ins); barkers Melnan Darkstone (Ironforge) / Kruban Darkblade (Orgrimmar)
dailies.zone: Elwynn Forest south of Goldshire (Nov 9-15 2026, Jan, Mar 2027) / Mulgore southwest of Thunder Bluff (Dec 7-13 2026, Feb, Apr 2027)
dailies.other_rewards: Tickets (voucher = 5, turn-ins 1-20 tickets by tier) for prizes such as Darkmoon Storage Box (50) and Steam Tonk Controller schematic (40)
dailies.how: Monthly, one week at a time. Costs gold in materials rather than paying gold.

dailies.name: More Al'Aketh Ears (Nightclaw Druids)
dailies.other_rewards: Nightclaw Druids reputation per 5 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears. Sources disagree: 200 rep (ConquestCapped / lfcarry) or 1,000 rep (Warcraft Tavern).
dailies.how: Unlocked after 'Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears'. Listed only because it is one of the few new repeatables; it is not a gold source.

writs.how_it_works: Sealed Journeyman's / Expert's / Artisan's Writs are envelopes that open (level 10+) into one random named order of that tier for Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Engineering, Leatherworking or Tailoring. wow.gg says 30 orders per profession (150). ConquestCapped counts 44 Journeyman, 60 Expert and 45 Artisan distinct orders. Right-click the named order to start a daily quest, then bring the requested item and the writ to the order's customer. You do not need the profession, and a purchased item works. Writs and orders are tradeable and sell on the AH. The payout is trade company reputation (Azeroth Commerce Authority for Alliance, Durotar Supply and Logistics for Horde) plus a Coin Pouch of silver.
writs.pickup: No board or vendor. Sealed writs are rare world drops from any mob (better from treasure chests), and from dungeons since the 9 Nov 2026 hotfix. They can also be bought on the Auction House: a Sealed Journeyman's Writ sold for about 15s to 1g on 12 Nov. Drop rates are not published.
writs.turnin: To the customer named on the order (shown on your map). Some customers show no quest marker, so right-click them anyway. The writ and item must be in your bags. Known customers (wow.gg table, ConquestCapped): Alan Sneeks (Alterac Mountains 30.6,61.0), Sos'mol (Alterac Mountains 38.4,61.2), Kixxle (Wetlands 50.2,37.8), Ziz Fizziks (Stonetalon Mountains 59.0,62.4), Muggol Breezebeard (Arathi Highlands 48.8,55.8), Alyce (Arathi Highlands 34.0,23.2), Gorgrash (Hillsbrad Foothills 80.0,48.2), Webbed Mudsnout Gnoll (Hillsbrad Foothills 62.2,69.2), Kzixx (Duskwood 81.8,19.8), Short John Mithril (Stranglethorn Vale 29.6,47.4), Scooty (Stranglethorn Vale 27.6,77.4), 'Plucky' Johnson (Thousand Needles 79.6,75.6), Ash'alari (Ashenvale 60.2,72.6), Cowardly Peon (Ashenvale 78.4,68.8). Expert examples: Spek (Riverglades), Scout Raroul (Feralas). Artisan examples: Kum'isha the Collector (Blasted Lands) and Hastings (Deadwind Pass), three orders each. Only 13 of 45 Artisan customers are known. Ziz Fizziks, Kixxle and Kzixx take 4-5 Journeyman orders each.
writs.rewards: Reputation: 75 Journeyman / 125 Expert / 200 Artisan (Diplomat Legacy talent adds up to 10%). Coin Pouch: about 22-45s Journeyman, about 50-90s Expert, about 75s average Artisan (ConquestCapped; other sources say only 'some silver'). No Merchant's Favor. The first writ or crate gives a Shipping Label: 2,000 rep + 50 Merchant's Favor + 660 XP, once per character. Reputation thresholds: Friendly 3,000, Honored 9,000, Revered 21,000, Exalted 42,000 total.
writs.limits: Each distinct order is a daily quest: once per day per order, with a timer counting to the daily reset after delivery. No shared cap across different orders (one player reportedly did 35 different writs in one day for 2,600+ rep). No weekly limit reported. Method reported a 9-hour timer starting on accept during testing, and ConquestCapped says 'some writs carry a timer'. Forger's Quill (15 Favor, Honored, from Dianne Softstep / Kurvelk Shadowhoof) rerolls a writ into a random writ of the same tier but does not reset the daily limit. The daily reset time is not stated by any source.
best_writs_for_profit: No source names a profitable writ. ConquestCapped: Expert orders need about 1g of goods against a 50-90s pouch, and Artisan orders about 2g against about 75s, so both usually lose gold.

Journeyman rule of thumb (ConquestCapped): only buy when the writ plus the item cost under about 50s. Examples at launch prices: a 15s Phoenix Pants writ needed over 3g of materials, and Shadow Goggles cost about 1.5g all in.

The gold play per the sources is to SELL writs you cannot use: unopened sealed writs (about 15s-1g on 12 Nov) and named orders, for crafters of that profession. Check the finished item's AH price before buying a named order.
Crafted Solid Shot is the outlier: it needs 200 units, not 1.

Alliance: NOTE: no source publishes a daily gold route, and the sources show no daily that nets real gold. The route below is built from the sourced stops. Weekly payout is about 10-100g vendor plus materials. Daily quest income is a few silver to about 1g of Coin Pouches, usually below the cost of the items.

WEEKLY 1 (after weekly reset; lfcarry says Tuesday 07:00 PST / 15:00 UTC for US, unverified, EU not given): Booty Bay, Pix Xizzix 28.4,75.8. Take this week's 'In Demand' quest (Dire Maul variant confirmed so far). Set your hearthstone to Booty Bay if you also fish on Sundays.

WEEKLY 2: Dire Maul, Feralas, in one group run: East (Pusillin for the Crescent Key, then Alzzin the Wildshaper), West (Prince Tortheldrin), North (King Gordok; tribute run counts). Each of these bosses also drops 1 Tarnished Undermine Real (daily per boss).

WEEKLY 3: Back to Pix. Open the Undermine Satchel, vendor the Gold Nugget / Quartz Gem / Silver Necklace / Gold Ring (10/20/40/100g), and post the materials (Essence of Air, Marefoil, Refined Deeprock Salt) on the AH. Timesaver estimate: about 38-58g US, 18-42g EU, about 130-148g best case.

DAILY (optional, reputation more than gold): while farming, keep every Sealed Writ and Waylaid Crate. Open the writs, check the AH price of the requested item, and deliver only cheap Journeyman orders (writ + item under about 50s) to their customers (e.g. Kixxle, Wetlands 50.2,37.8; Kzixx, Duskwood 81.8,19.8; Muggol Breezebeard / Alyce, Arathi Highlands). List the rest on the AH.
DAILY (optional): Three Corners, Redridge Mountains: Marcy Baker 9.6,70.9 for sealed crate turn-ins (Merchant's Favor + a few silver). Or sell unfilled crates on the AH (about 17-30s in week one).

DAILY (optional, no gold): Darkspear Islands. Win a match, then turn in 'The Battle for Darkspear Islands!' to Brelinda McFarry, Northwatch Hold, Barrens 63.4,58.8 (200 rep + Honor; daily limit unconfirmed). Turn in 3 marks to an Alliance Brigadier General.
DAILY (optional, no gold): one round of 55+ dungeons for Tarnished Undermine Real (1 per boss per day, cap 250). Not convertible to gold.

GOLD FILLER at 60 (ConquestCapped, 15 Nov AH scan, PvP realm): Devilsaurs in Un'Goro (about 1g70s per kill with Skinning), Firetail Scorpids in Burning Steppes around 26,57 (about 36s with Skinning), Cyclone Warriors in Silithus around 41,58 (about 36s). Normal dungeon groups make about 24g/hour (early player reports).
SUNDAY 2 pm server time: Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza (Expert Fishing). 40 Speckled Tastyfish to Riggle Bassbait in Booty Bay. Leftover fish buy coin bags from Jang (amounts not stated).
ONE-TIME: hand in any unfinished quest of quest level 48+ (these pay gold since the 10 Nov hotfix; amounts not published; some players report Hyjal quests paying no gold at 60).
Horde: NOTE: same caveat as Alliance. No daily that nets real gold is documented. The weekly Pix quest is the only recurring gold quest (about 10-100g vendor plus materials).
WEEKLY 1 (after weekly reset; lfcarry says Tuesday 15:00 UTC for US, unverified): Booty Bay (neutral), Pix Xizzix 28.4,75.8. Take this week's 'In Demand' quest.
WEEKLY 2: Dire Maul, Feralas: East (Pusillin key, Alzzin the Wildshaper), West (Prince Tortheldrin), North (King Gordok). Loot the Reals from each boss too.
WEEKLY 3: Back to Pix. Vendor the satchel's gold item (10/20/40/100g) and sell the materials on the AH.

DAILY (optional, reputation more than gold): deliver cheap Journeyman writs to their customers. Customers near Horde routes include Ziz Fizziks (Stonetalon Mountains 59.0,62.4), Ash'alari / Cowardly Peon (Ashenvale 60.2,72.6 / 78.4,68.8), 'Plucky' Johnson (Thousand Needles 79.6,75.6), Gorgrash (Hillsbrad Foothills 80.0,48.2). Sell unusable writs on the AH.

DAILY (optional): Durotar Supply and Logistics camp, west gate of the Crossroads, The Barrens: Dokimi (Method 50.0,29.2) for sealed crate turn-ins (Merchant's Favor + a few silver). Or sell unfilled crates on the AH.

DAILY (optional, no gold): Darkspear Islands. Win, then turn in 'The Battle for Darkspear Islands!' to Nizook Boof, Merchant Coast 65.0,34.8 (200 rep + Honor; daily limit unconfirmed). Turn in 3 marks to a Horde Warbringer.
DAILY (optional, no gold): 55+ dungeon bosses for Tarnished Undermine Real.

GOLD FILLER at 60: same farm spots as Alliance (Un'Goro Devilsaurs about 1g70s per kill with Skinning, Burning Steppes Firetail Scorpids about 36s, Silithus Cyclone Warriors about 36s), or dungeon groups at about 24g/hour (early reports).
SUNDAY 2 pm server time: Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza in Booty Bay (Riggle Bassbait, 40 Speckled Tastyfish).
ONE-TIME: turn in leftover quests of quest level 48+ for their added gold.

disagreements_and_unverified: Weekly quest variants: warcraft.wiki.gg lists 4 Pix 'In Demand' weeklies (Ancient Elven Curiosities, Blackrock Legal Records, Plague Records, Titan Relics), all added in 1.60.1. Every guide (Timesaver, ezg, kami-labs/MeinMMO, ConquestCapped) reports only the Dire Maul one, offered in both of the first two weekly cycles. Rotation is unconfirmed.

Weekly quest pickup: an Icy Veins search snippet said you pick it up from King Gordok or Prince Tortheldrin. Every other source (Timesaver, ConquestCapped, Wowhead, wiki) says Pix Xizzix gives and takes it. Icy Veins was 403 and could not be read.
Satchel odds: lfcarry gives 40/35/20/5% and a 24g average. ConquestCapped, ezg and kami-labs say the odds are not published. Treat the lfcarry weights as unverified.
Weekly reset time: only lfcarry (a boost seller) states Tuesday 07:00 PST / 15:00 UTC. The daily reset time is not stated anywhere.
Writ Coin Pouch value: ConquestCapped gives silver ranges per tier. Method, wow-professions and wow.gg say only 'some silver' / 'small amount of silver'.
Writ timer: Method saw a 9-hour timer from accept in testing. ConquestCapped says some writs carry a timer and that a delivered order counts down to the daily reset.
Tarnished Undermine Real cap: 250 (live tooltip per ConquestCapped) vs 165 (beta, still repeated by sellers).
Horde trade camp coords: Method 49.4,28.9 vs warcraft.wiki.gg 42,34 (likely different map references).
Nightclaw 'More Al'Aketh Ears': 200 rep (ConquestCapped/lfcarry) vs 1,000 rep (Warcraft Tavern) per 5 ears.
Darkspear win quest daily limit: unconfirmed either way.
Shen'dralas: no source documents any daily or repeatable quest there. Classic Shen'dralar Libram turn-ins may or may not carry over.
Several sources (ConquestCapped, lfcarry, Timesaver, ezg) also sell gold or boosts. Their price and gold-per-hour figures are their own estimates.
